rationale: Pre-Proto-Oceanic is a stage before Proto-Oceanic, not Proto-Oceanic; the glottocode lookup gives it ocea1241 only because MCD reuses the family's code. Wiktionary has no code for it.
Pre-Proto-Micronesian is a stage before Proto-Micronesian; MCD reuses micr1243. Wiktionary has no code for it.
Dempwolff's Uraustronesisch, cited by MCD as his reconstructions in his notation; not Wiktionary's Proto-Austronesian (map-pro), as the ACD's Dempwolff forms are not.
Proto-Polynesian is poly1242; the catalog also gives that glottocode to Wiktionary's Eastern Polynesian (poz-pep-pro), as for the ACD's Proto-Polynesian.
